conviction_note: The 9M report is real and due 13 Nov, but Eurotech releases after the close (H1 at 20:28 on 11 Sep, FY25 at 20:30 on 16 Mar), so the reaction falls on Monday 16 Nov. The print brings new numbers on a two-analyst, $0.26m/day name, so abs_move is 6%. A broker said in September that Q3 orders slipped into Q4, the stock has run up 12% in five days on a €7.7m insider raise priced at €1.17, and Q3 net debt probably rose on component working capital. Against that, the regional public fund put fresh money in days before the print and peer SECO had a record Q3. That leaves a slight lean down, p_up 45, giving -0.6, in line with the findings' sum of -0.4.

already_public.what: H1 2026: revenue €25.2m (+17.1%), adjusted EBITDA -€1.4m, Q2 EBITDA at break-even, net debt €7.2m at 30 June, management expects H2 revenue growth from backlog

Alantra roadshow note: plan targets reiterated (EBITDA positive FY26, EBIT positive FY27, ~€80m revenue 2028), strong Q4 expected partly on orders that slipped out of Q3, Japan heading for a record year
Emera commits up to €1m more in capital contributions within 2026 for working capital tied to component supply conditions and the VEM Solutions branch acquisition
Board resolution of 10 Nov: €7.68m capital increase reserved to Emera, La Società Privata and Friulia at €1.170 a share; Friulia subscribed its €1.5m on 11 Nov

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue against €13.7m in Q3 2025 (9M25 €35.18m less H1 €21.5m). Probably modest growth, held back by orders slipping into Q4. A slight miss against the 'H2 growth' narrative is possible.

Net debt at 30 Sept probably above June's €7.2m because of component inventory build and working capital, which Emera's October commitment itself cites. Negative on this line, though the reserved raise offsets it pro forma.
No numeric guide expected. The likely statement reiterates a return to positive FY26 EBITDA on a strong Q4. Softening that would be the real downside risk; the base case is a reiteration.
Possible order-intake or backlog colour and Japan commentary. Unknown.

bar: No sourced consensus for Q3; the baseline has two analysts and no estimate. The company bar is the H1 statement ('permette al Gruppo di prevedere una crescita dei ricavi nel secondo semestre', https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/229_2026-09-11_TLB/Eurotech-si-riduce-il-deficit-della-gestione-operativa-nel-primo-semestre.html) plus the plan's FY26 EBITDA-positive target reiterated via Alantra. Q3 2025 comparison is €13.7m revenue with EBITDA at break-even. Every bar-dependent finding is capped small.
session_check: amc. Eurotech's 2026 calendar (CS 18 Dec 2025) puts board approval of the 30 Sept interim report on 13 Nov 2026 (https://www.eurotech.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/20251218_CS_IT.pdf). Its recent results all went out after the close: H1 2026 at 20:28 CEST on 11 Sep (https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/229_2026-09-11_TLB/Eurotech-si-riduce-il-deficit-della-gestione-operativa-nel-primo-semestre.html), with the price reaction on 14 Sep; FY25 at 20:30 on 16 Mar (https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/03/16/eurotech-accelera-nel-2025-con-una-redditivita-in-significativo-miglioramento-233.html); 9M24 covered at 08:36 the next morning (https://www.teleborsa.it/AMP/News/2024/11/15/eurotech-la-perdita-dei-9-mesi-si-allarga-a-7-9-milioni-di-euro-29.html). 13 Nov 2026 is a Friday, so expect the release that evening and the reaction on Mon 16 Nov. The sealed bmo window (close 12 Nov to close 13 Nov) very likely holds no release.
positioning_check: The CONSOB posizioni nette corte register (PncPubbl.xlsx, as of 2026-11-11) was read and does not name Eurotech. That is the 0.5% truncation floor, not a measured zero, and anchor_covered is false, so there is no positioning anchor and priced_lean_pct (-0.18) is just the run-up. Building or covering is unknown. Ownership is concentrated (Emera about 36% after the raise) and float is thin.

findings.finding: Alantra's 23 Sep roadshow note said management expects a strong Q4 supported partly by orders that slipped out of Q3, so Q3 revenue and EBITDA are likely softer than an even H2 ramp would imply.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (revenue +29%): the stock rose 6.7% on release day and gave back 6.2% the next. H1 2026 (Q2 EBITDA break-even): +2.7% and then -3.4% over the following two sessions. Quarterly surprises here retrace.
findings.original_quote: Alantra segnala inoltre l'attesa per un forte quarto trimestre, sostenuto anche da alcuni ordini slittati dal terzo trimestre (Alantra also flags the expectation of a strong fourth quarter, supported in part by some orders that slipped from the third quarter)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The note is public and seven weeks old. But it ran only in Italian wire copy on a two-analyst name with no published Q3 number, so nobody has a figure to anchor on. Had the market fully absorbed a soft Q3, the stock would not be at €1.30, 11% above the €1.17 insider raise price and above Intesa's €1.10 target, after a 12% five-day run.
findings.independence: Kontron (a direct peer) said its guide depends on shipping delayed products held up by component shortages: https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/kontron-aktie-prognose-bestatigt-auftragsbestand-wachst-trotz-umsatzruckgang

findings.finding: Q3 net debt is likely worse than June's €7.2m. On 23 Oct Emera committed another €1m explicitly for working capital arising from component supply conditions (memory/GPU price rises, selective inventory build) and the VEM branch acquisition, and that line will be visible in the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history on net debt alone. Net debt fell sharply in H1 on the rights issue, and the stock still drifted lower after H1.
findings.original_quote: Le suddette risorse saranno funzionali a far fronte al [fabbisogno di capitale circolante] derivante dall'evolversi delle condizioni del mercato di approvvigionamento dei componenti e dell'acquisizione del ramo di azienda di VEM Solutions (These resources will serve to meet the [working-capital need] arising from changing conditions in the component supply market and from the acquisition of the VEM Solutions business branch). The bracketed words are reconstructed from WebFetch's summary of the same page.
findings.why_not_priced: The Sept 30 net debt figure has not been published. The run-up after the reserved raise shows the market reading the financing as de-risking, not as a sign that Q3 consumed cash. Had the market priced a Q3 cash burn, the stock would not have rallied 12% into the print.
findings.independence: Alantra (23 Sep) separately reported selective inventory build to secure component availability: https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/63_2026-09-23_TLB/Eurotech-Alantra-conferma-Buy-il-Giappone-e-i-nuovi-design-win-sostengono-il-turnaround.html

findings.finding: On 10 Nov, three days before the print, the board approved a €7.68m capital increase reserved to Emera, La Società Privata and the regional fund Friulia at €1.170 a share, and Friulia subscribed €1.5m of fresh money on 11 Nov. Holders who know the Q3 numbers are adding capital to fund working capital and growth rather than plug a gap.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose +3.9%, +4.3% and +4.7% over 9 to 11 Nov (545k shares on 11 Nov, about twice normal). The financing has already been rewarded.
findings.original_quote: a un prezzo di sottoscrizione pari a 1,170 euro per azione ... con termine di sottoscrizione entro il 30 novembre 2026 (at a subscription price of €1.170 per share ... subscription deadline 30 November 2026)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 12% five-day run-up is this news. What is left is the confidence signal of insiders subscribing just before the Q3 numbers: a placement to holders with knowledge makes a profit warning in the print less likely. Small and positive, after asking what the money buys: component working capital, VEM and the relaunch plan, which the Q4 order slip corroborates.
findings.independence: Friulia's own subscription notice: https://www.teleborsa.it/News/2026/11/11/eurotech-friulia-sottoscrive-integralmente-la-parte-di-aumento-di-capitale-ad-essa-riservata-273.html (the same issuer stream, so not independent of the fact itself)

findings.finding: Italian edge-computing peer SECO reported a record Q3 2026 on 9 Nov (revenue about €59.6m, +24%) on Edge AI demand, a positive sector read-through for Eurotech's end markets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history for peer read-through on this name.
findings.original_quote: SECO, utile adjusted sale a 12,7 milioni di euro nei 9 mesi, ricavi +8,1% (headline: SECO, adjusted profit rises to €12.7m in 9M, revenue +8.1%)
findings.why_not_priced: Proxy only. SECO's Q3 was guided at about €60m back in July, and the run-up from 9 Nov may already include it. Eurotech's own Q3 order slip limits how far this transmits, so it is sized small.

outside_window.finding: The €7.68m reserved capital increase has a subscription deadline of 30 Nov 2026. Completing it adds about €7.7m of equity against the Sept net-debt figure.
Whether FY26 EBITDA turns positive depends on a strong Q4, which resolves with the FY26 results in March 2027.

searched_and_found_nothing: No Q3 consensus or broker preview found; Intesa (TP €1.10, 17 Sep) and Alantra (TP €1.50) carry no published Q3 number in the snippets reached
No MAR Art. 17 guidance revision or profit warning before the print: the Teleborsa Eurotech news list shows only the Emera commitment (23 Oct) and the reserved raise (10-11 Nov)
Kontron Q3 2026 coverage gives no memory-price commentary to tie to Eurotech
eMarket STORAGE not queried directly; Teleborsa's mirror of the regulated releases covered the issuer stream

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly against the +12.3% five-day run-up, which was built on financing news that is now priced. The baseline's -0.18 lean is just the run-up because there is no short anchor. So the small negative partly agrees with the free control and does not beat it with independent positioning.
language_note: Every load-bearing source was Italian: Teleborsa's wire copy of the issuer's releases carried the release timestamps (20:28 and 20:30) that settle the session as amc; English searches did not return them
The Alantra roadshow note on orders slipping from Q3 to Q4 ('ordini slittati dal terzo trimestre') appeared only in Italian wire copy

Emera's 23 Oct commitment and its stated purpose (component supply working capital), and the 10-11 Nov reserved raise at €1.17 with Friulia's subscription, were reported in Italian first; Teleborsa's English translations exist but no English search surfaced them
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0' (reported_quarter findings 4 of 14): the Alantra Q3-slip finding was shrunk from -0.8 to -0.5 because the slip has been public since 23 Sep
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): kept the working-capital/net-debt finding and moved it from -0.5 to -0.6

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and the thin-coverage regime: abs_move_pct raised from 5.5 to 6.0. The numbers are new and the name trades $0.26m/day with two analysts, but no guidance change is expected, so it stays below the 7% base
'Your own session check was right three times': session_check opens with 'amc' and cites the issuer's timestamps so the resolver uses the evening-release window
